svg.text: Granularity disintegrators: break a service apart
Service scope and function: doing too many unrelated things?
Code volatility: changes isolated to one part?
Scalability and throughput: parts need to scale differently?
Fault tolerance: one part crashes the rest?
Granularity integrators: put services back together
Database transactions: ACID needed across services?
Workflow and choreography: do the services talk to each other?
Shared code: do they share domain code?
Data relationships: can the data be split too?
Aim for equilibrium; teams often over-focus on
